ads.name: FREEDOM-ONETAKE-VER
ads.campaign_name: CRO LUX GULET - Avgust 2026 - Nova konverzija
ads.body:
This is what a family holiday is supposed to feel like.

Most family trips look perfect in the photos. 

In real life, someone's always packing, driving, translating a menu, or breaking up an argument over who gets which cabin.

A private crewed gulet in Croatia works differently. 

Your own crew handles breakfast, lunch, and every detail in between. 

Your kids have the whole deck to run around on. You actually sit down and decompress. 

Your parents move at their own pace instead of everyone else's.

Every morning brings a new location: quiet water, an island town, a beach nobody else has found yet.

At Goolets, we match families with the right yacht, crew, and route along the Croatian coast, so the week is easy for everyone on board, not just the kids.

Start planning a family week on the Adriatic today
